title: Lester's high voice, rumours about him, and his son the doctor
summary: Phillips says Lester did not sing because his voice was too high, mentions rumours about his sexuality, and says his son became a doctor and keeps in touch with Phillips.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You told me something about Lester one time. You said something about the reason he didn't sing was because...
His voice was too high. See, Les had a fine voice. Because a whole lot of people said he was gay.
People said he was gay.
Yeah, but I never know nothin'... Could have been he was, because you never know a man's private business. He was still gay, but he was getting babies -- he had two babies.
Two babies.
Two kids.
When was this? You mean later on?
Yeah, he got a son!
I thought you were talking about something way back.

Oh, no. A son and a daughter now. His son is a doctor. He graduated recently. He sent me an invitation to the graduation. Must have been about a couple of years ago. I think he's practicing now. And he wrote and told me that he was going to have a shower for his baby. See, they think of me like I'm related to them, you know what I mean?
Where does he live now?
He lives in New York. Is it Lackawanna, New York?
I don't know where...
Yeah, I think it's something like that.
Phillips - 90

That's something like Long Island, like that. And he lives there. Everybody thought he was going to be a musician. He was playing around with clarinet. But he just wasn't into it. And Mary said, his mother told me...
Mary, that's Lester Young's widow?

Yeah. Mary told me, said, 'Yes, Phil, he did not want that horn at all.' He started to go to medical. He wanted to be a doctor. So that's what he is. That ain't bad company -- a doctor! That's where all the money is now. Because look at me. I went to the doctor yesterday, it cost me almost a hundred dollars. You know what I mean?
Yeah, I'll bet.
That's right.
